markers.reading: Sura reports a before-dawn attack and a ceasefire shortly before her local noon; the DM estimates the latter as roughly 1–3 p.m. in Drankor.

evidence.quote: Yeah. She updates you a little. “On the morning before dawn, the Chardonian wizards rained fire on our camps with an evil wind that fanned the flames into an inferno.” They fled, taking shelter along the river where they could. “But sometime shortly before noon”—should have been like 3 or set or 2 in the afternoon here, or something like that, or one—“the most amazing and unexpected thing happened. A woman riding fast on a phantom steed steed chased us down, waving a flag of parley. She spoke urgently, claiming that the commander of the Chardonian legions, General Marius Cusico, had called a halt to hostilities, saying that he had come to realize the gods did not want this war, and he had ordered his legions to retreat back to Chardon and pray for further guidance. Indeed, he said, he actually asked for aid if possible, as a small contingent of his wizards and legions—not many, but enough to cause trouble—had refused to acknowledge his command and fled camp. We agreed to send a scouting party, at least to see if how many there were. But if he's retreating, not going to ask them to stay to deal with whatever small number of wizards and legions may remain. I don't know what you did, but I appreciate that.”

time.basis: Sura explicitly places the ceasefire shortly before local noon on the reported day; year from YAML and day from the current May 24 message.

markers.note: This dates earlier events in Sura’s western clock. The DM’s loose one/two/three p.m. conversion spans the midday/afternoon watch boundary in Drankor, and supplies no exact synchronization or extra elapsed day.

yamlCheck.dateAnchor: May 24 is independently spoken at the opening and confirmed during the crown discussion. The year 1749 comes only from YAML. Sunset, an overnight long rest, and the next dawn place the following expedition on May 25 conditional on that year.
yamlCheck.explanation: The source covers May 24 through the following dawn and expedition, contradicting the same-day YAML end. The retrospective short rest and ship turnaround belong before the opening teleport on the first day; earlier background rest does not add another night. No additional rest is established after Delwath’s revival.
